scientific_limitations_and_integrity.priority_risk: Moon and Moser (1966) proved qualitative typical primitive exponent two; their full original paper was not available for quantitative-content inspection. A sharp constant or defect law there, or in other random-digraph literature, would affect novelty.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.proven_scope: For independent fixed-density Bernoulli matrices, the first-order sharp failure probability of universal Boolean squaring, the unique off-diagonal missing-pair law, and the conditioned uniform multipermutation specialization.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.unproved_or_excluded: No claims for sparse density tending to zero, no exact general finite-n failure formula, no independent scientific audit, no definitive global priority claim.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.verification: Independent-of-derivation brute Boolean multiplication through four vertices confirms exact marginal formulas and small counts; the infinite asymptotic relies on the provided Bonferroni proof.

title: Sharp two-step absorption and the unique-defect law for random multipermutations
